title: 3D Optimization for Web Configurator | Fusion 360 FBX → GLB / Three.js
desc:
Summary
We are VAN-Jorn, a manufacturer of modular campervans, and we are looking for an experienced **3D artist / technical 3D specialist** to prepare and optimize our Fusion 360 models for our online **Three.js 3D configurator**.

Our source models come from Autodesk Fusion 360 and can be supplied as `.FBX`. We need these converted into clean, lightweight and visually high-quality `.GLB` assets.

We already have a detailed technical optimization guide from our configurator developer.

## Project scope

The current project consists of approximately **60 main assets**, resulting in roughly **70–90 final GLB files** because several models require mirrored, empty, open/closed or other variants.

We want to complete the project in two phases.

### Phase 1 – Cleanup & preparation
**Deadline: September 15, 2026**

The first phase focuses on getting the models technically ready for our configurator:

- Clean up Fusion 360 / FBX hierarchy
- Remove unnecessary empties and objects
- Export to GLB
- Consistent orientation, front facing +Y
- Correct and consistent pivots / origins
- Maintain exact positioning between different assets
- Separate configurable components where necessary
- Consistent file naming

The geometry does not yet need to be fully optimized during Phase 1.

### Phase 2 – Full web optimization
**Deadline: November 3, 2026**

We preferably want the same freelancer to also complete Phase 2:

- Strong polygon reduction / low-poly optimization
- Remove invisible and unne

title: Bangalore Sports Highlight Videographer
desc:
I need a skilled videographer-editor based in Bangalore to capture individual-sport action and turn it into an energetic highlight reel. The reel will feature tennis and swimming, so you’ll be filming courtside and poolside, then crafting a concise, engaging cut that shows the best moments and conveys the excitement of each discipline. Delivering 8 reels a month. 

You’ll handle the full workflow: on-location shooting, selecting standout clips, adding smooth transitions, basic motion graphics or lower-thirds where helpful, colour correction, sound design, and final export ready for web and social. I can be on site to coordinate access and schedules; the creative eye and technical setup are yours.

Deliverables
• Finished highlight reel (H.264, 1080p or higher)
• One social-media-ready teaser (≤30 sec)
• All project files and organised raw footage

If you work comfortably with mirrorless/DSLR or cinema cameras, gimbals, and Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, you’ll fit right in. Let me know about similar tennis or swimming projects you’ve shot, what gear you plan to use, and your typical turnaround time.

title: Automated Excel Performance Dashboard
desc:
I need a single Excel workbook that turns my monthly sales and inventory figures into clear, automated insights. Once I drop raw data into a dedicated sheet, every other page in the file should refresh instantly, giving me:  

• Dynamic graphs and charts that highlight month-to-month performance shifts  
• Clean summary tables for quick reference  
• Pivot tables I can slice by product line, region, or any future field I add  

The focus is purely on reporting and analysis—no transaction entry or stock-count tools are necessary. I’m happy for you to lean on Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, or standard formulas, as long as the end result updates with one click (or better, on open) and stays easy for a non-technical user to maintain.  

Hand-over will include the finished workbook, a brief walkthrough video or document explaining where to paste new data, and confirmation that all visuals recalculate correctly with sample updates.

desc:

Day-to-day execution can be handled in the toolset you prefer—Meta Business Suite, Hootsuite, Buffer, Later or native schedulers—so long as publishing runs smoothly and performance can be tracked. I’ll review analytics weekly and adjust strategy together, so clear reporting is important.

Deliverables I’d like handed over at minimum:
• Live, fully branded profiles on each agreed platform

title: Dark Fantasy Superhero Novel
desc:
I already hold a detailed AI-generated prompt that maps out the plot, characters, and worldbuilding for a fantasy-based, dark-and-gritty superhero saga driven by an anti-hero lead. What I now need is an established author who can translate that skeleton into a living, breathing novel—something unmistakably human in voice, emotion, and craft.

You would take my document and expand it into a full-length, one-of-a-kind manuscript that I can publish and sell under my name. Expect morally gray choices, sweeping yet shadow-soaked set pieces, and a protagonist whose powers are matched only by their inner turmoil. I’m aiming for a true page-turner that balances cinematic action with layered character work.

Deliverables  
• Complete novel manuscript (80–100k words or the natural length the story demands)  
• Brief synopsis and back-cover blurb suitable for marketing  
• Chapter titles and a clean table of contents  
• One round of revisions after my detailed feedback  
• Final, polished file in both Word and PDF, with all rights transferred to me upon payment  

Proper pacing, natural dialogue, and fresh, vivid prose are essential; genre tropes are welcome only when they feel earned. If you have prior fantasy or superhero credits, let me know—the darker and more character-driven, the better.

Timeline and milestones are flexible as long as quality remains paramount. Let’s craft a masterpiece together.

title: Uji Aplikasi Penghasil Uang
desc:

Tugasnya sederhana: instal aplikasi yang saya berikan, selesaikan misi dasar sampai saldo bisa ditarik, lalu buktikan proses penarikan berhasil melalui e-wallet—idealnya OVO atau GoPay karena itulah metode yang saya utamakan.  

Yang saya butuhkan dari Anda:

• Catatan singkat waktu yang dihabiskan, kesulitan yang ditemui, dan jumlah saldo minimum sebelum penarikan bisa dilakukan.  
• Penilaian singkat apakah fitur penarikan saldo memang mudah dipakai.  

Bila aplikasi ternyata juga mendukung opsi lain seperti transfer bank atau PayPal, catat saja sebagai informasi tambahan—fokus utama tetap pada e-wallet. Laporan akhir cukup berupa file PDF atau Google Docs yang merangkum temuan Anda beserta bukti visual. Saya hanya membutuhkan satu orang yang benar-benar teliti, terbiasa memakai OVO atau GoPay, dan dapat menyelesaikan pengujian ini secepat mungkin.

title: Need marketing expert to drive Organic Traffic for Education Site notescart.com
desc:
My website caters specifically to students and teachers, so I need steady, laser-targeted traffic that arrives naturally—no paid ads, no bots, and no mass-submission tricks. I want to see genuine educators and learners discovering our pages because they were searching for exactly what we offer.

Scope of work  
• Analyse the site’s current visibility and spot quick-win keywords within the student–teacher niche.  
• Develop an on-page SEO plan (titles, meta, schema, internal links) that keeps the academic audience front-and-centre.  
• Shape a content strategy that earns backlinks organically—think lesson-plan round-ups, study tips, or teacher resource guides—then outline a realistic publishing calendar.  
• Build authority through ethical outreach: guest posts on respected education blogs, collaborations with teaching influencers, and thoughtful engagement in academic forums or subreddits.  
• Track progress with Google Analytics and Search Console, highlighting qualified sessions and ranking gains rather than raw hit counts.

Acceptance criteria  
A successful engagement will show:  
1. Noticeable growth in organic sessions from education-related queries.  
2. Improved positions for niche academic keywords we agree on at kickoff.  
3. Traffic quality metrics—time on page, pages per session—consistent with real student/teacher interest.

title: Illustrative Logo Design With Abstract Shapes
desc:
I’m developing a lifestyle-focused personal blog and want a logo that instantly signals creativity and freshness. The direction is illustrative rather than purely typographic or minimalistic, and I picture clean, modern lines built around abstract shapes that feel dynamic without becoming busy. Colour and typography choices should reinforce a warm yet contemporary vibe and hold up equally well on Instagram posts, website headers, business cards, and larger print pieces.

Here’s how I’d like the process to run: start by presenting two-to-three distinct concept sketches so I can react to overall mood, palette, and composition. Once we lock in a favourite, we’ll fine-tune spacing, colour variations, and any tag-line placement through a round or two of revisions until it feels spot-on.

For hand-off, I’ll need:
• High-resolution PNG and JPG in both full-colour and monochrome versions  
• A scalable vector/source file (AI, EPS or SVG) with fonts either outlined or included  
• A brief style guide noting colour codes and typography so the look stays consistent across future assets

If you have questions about the brand voice or want to suggest unexpected abstract motifs, just let me know—creative input is welcome as long as the final mark remains clean, modern, and unmistakably mine.

title: Cinematic AI Movie Video Editor
desc:
I’m putting together a story-driven AI movie and I need an editor who can elevate the raw, model-generated footage into a polished cinematic experience. The core of the job revolves around three creative pillars:  

• Special effects that merge seamlessly with the AI-rendered scenes  
• Rich, film-style color grading that reinforces mood and atmosphere  
• Detailed sound design to anchor every beat of the narrative  

You’ll receive pre-rendered sequences (4K, 24 fps), prompt notes, reference clips, and the dialogue stems. I’m open to whichever professional suite you work fastest in—Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci, or a comparable tool—so long as you can deliver:  

1. A locked picture edit approved via timestamped review links  
2. Full SFX and ambience layers delivered as separate stems  
3. A final 4K master (ProRes or DNxHR) plus a lightly compressed H.264 for online viewing  

I’ll review rough cuts, VFX passes, and the final grade against these acceptance criteria: frame-accurate effects integration, consistent LUT application across scenes, and balanced audio that peaks no higher than –6 dB. Timelines are flexible within reason, but clear communication and regular progress updates are essential.  

If you thrive on cinematic storytelling and love pushing AI footage to the next level, let’s talk and set our first milestone.
